## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Equities show broad participation with SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND signaling easing fear, while credit signals (HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) RECOVERY) and CPER/GLD divergences create the conflict that defines CAUTION.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Stocks vs Bonds showing RISK-ON tilt: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY → SPY/TLT ↑ rising. Credit stress flicker: Credit Spread (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +0.78%) CORRECTION and mixed HYG/LQD readings signal caution.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar softer: Dollar strength (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND → dollar easing. Duration portrait mixed: TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY and Yield Curve (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY — modest steepening but uneven.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.03%) RECOVERY showing momentum; Materials/XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND also strong. Energy and Utilities lag: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum leadership (XLK up) with broad sector participation.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforming: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND. China mixed: FXI (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) CORRECTION and EM EEM (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) RECOVERY — selective EM strength but uneven.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation rising: ARKK (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY and IWM (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on speculative flows; IBIT (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND confirms crypto ETF demand.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Gold and silver strong: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND, while industrial metals CPER (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND — a mix of safe‑haven and cyclical commodity strength that feeds the CAUTION signal.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed/correcting: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION show 1W weakness vs 1M gains; nat gas UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity advance — SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Energy/commodity CORRECTIONs (BNO, USO, XLE) show 1W negative vs 1M positive — minor divergence; no MAJOR divergence across core equities (SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure given XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector breadth, but reduce exposure to volatile commodity/energy ETFs (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION) until 1W/1M align; bonds neutral with TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION — watch for further 1W weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency), Credit spread/ HYG-LQD watch zone (~0.75–0.85) for credit stress, SPY support near recent breakout (SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND), XLK/XLF relative pivot to monitor for style rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but mixed credit and commodity signals create conflicting risk cues. XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) and broad equity ETFs (SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while energy/commodities (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION) and credit spreads warrant close monitoring.
